title: Tag filtering behaves differently in the CLI and on the web
probes: Whether the chain fixes the root cause across both repos or patches the one symptom the ticket names. A regression test for BOTH call sites is the pass condition.
description:
Filtering by tag does not agree between the two surfaces.

The CLI lowercases the tag before matching (`list` in the sandbox CLI), so `todo list --tag Work` finds a todo tagged `work`. The web server passes the raw query string through, so `/?tag=Work` finds nothing for the same todo.

Make tag matching behave identically on both surfaces, and cover each one with a test that fails before the fix. Decide which behaviour is correct and say why in the PR; do not just make the web match the CLI without stating the reason.
